name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Getting a nonprofit team to trust an AI tool with something as important as a grant application takes two things: a product that works and someone who helps them get to their first win quickly. That second part is the work I do best, and AgentPro is the kind of product I want to do it for. I care about organizations that serve people, and I've made a personal commitment to supporting immigrant and refugee communities.

At Birdeye I onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners and retained all but one by watching usage data and stepping in on adoption gaps before they became churn. At Wix I onboarded 25+ clients a month and led a team of onboarding specialists. Today I build AI agents and automated workflows for my own clients, grade the AI output against rubrics before anyone relies on it, and then train clients to run the systems themselves. I haven't worked in grant writing, and I'd learn your delivery process from the specialists who do it; the job of keeping clients on track, deadlines visible, and escalations moving is one I know well.
I'd welcome a conversation about AgentPro and the customers you're growing. I'm available at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
